name: photo-palette
description: Generate clean, perceptually balanced color palettes from photographs and images.

interface.shortDescription: Turn any photo into a clean color palette
interface.longDescription: Extracts a clean, harmonious color palette from photographs. Colors are clustered in the perceptual OKLab space, de-muddied (averaging and edge-blend colors are suppressed), de-duplicated and mapped to UI roles (background, surface, text, primary, accent). Choose clean, natural, vivid or muted finishes and export as CSS variables, SCSS, Tailwind v4 @theme, JSON, SVG swatches or a GIMP/Inkscape/Krita palette.
defaultPrompt: Generate a clean color palette from this photo
Make a CSS theme from the colors in hero.jpg
Build one moodboard palette from all images in ./refs
